shellCommands.command: npm view @gravity-ui/navigation versions --json | tail -30; echo ---; npm view @gravity-ui/navigation@2 peerDependencies; echo ---; npm view @gravity-ui/icons version
for v in 3.0.0 4.0.0 5.0.0 6.0.0 6.6.1 7.0.0 7.1.3; do echo "== navigation@$v"; npm view @gravity-ui/navigation@$v peerDependencies 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'uikit|icons|components'; done

ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null || echo "no uikit build/docs"; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null || echo "no uikit dist/docs"; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/ ; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/dist 2>/dev/null | head

grep -rn "useTheme\b" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ --include=*.d.ts | head; echo ---; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ---; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ---; grep -rn "export" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts

cat /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/FooterItem/FooterItem.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ===LOGO; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/Logo/Logo.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo ===INDEX; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.d.ts

grep -rn "renderContent\|onChangeCompact\|hideCollapseButton\|renderFooter" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeaderContext.d.ts /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -20; echo ===; grep -rn -B3 -A20 "interface LogoProps" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons; for n in House Gear Sun Moon CircleInfo Rocket Sliders Palette Star; do if [ -f "esm/$n.js" ] || [ -f "build/esm/$n.js" ]; then echo "OK $n"; else echo "MISSING $n"; fi; done; ls | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; echo "=== Switch"; sed -n 1,60p Switch/Switch.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "=== Card"; grep -n "CardType\|CardView\|interface CardProps" -A12 Card/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -50

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -n -A15 "interface ControlProps" components/types.d.ts | head -25; echo "=== Card"; ls components/Card/; sed -n 1,40p components/Card/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -rn "header-1\|subheader-1\|body-1" components/Text/types.d.ts | head -8; echo "=== sp export"; grep -n "spacing\|export.*sp\b" index.d.ts | head -10; echo "=== FooterItem export in navigation"; grep -rn "FooterItem" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -5
ls components/Text/ && grep -rn "variant" components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -5; echo "=== Card.d.ts"; sed -n 1,50p components/Card/Card.d.ts
sed -n 1,30p components/Text/Text.d.ts; echo "=== text-styles variants"; grep -rn "header-1" components/Text/text/*.d.ts components/Text/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5

grep -rn "export" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | grep -i "spacing\|layout" | head -5; grep -rn "declare function sp\|declare const sp\|spacing" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/styles/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -8; grep -rn "ButtonView = " /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/*.d.ts | head -3

grep -rn "BUTTON_VIEWS" components/Button/constants.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; grep -rn "action" components/Button/constants.d.ts | head -3; echo "=== sp"; grep -rln "declare function sp\|declare const sp" --include=*.d.ts . | head -4

grep -rn "gap\|spacing" components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -10; echo ===; grep -n "export.*from.*layout" index.d.ts | head -5; grep -rn "export.*sp\b\|export {sp" components/layout/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5

head -5 /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.js; echo "=== nav styles entry"; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/styles* 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "styles" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | head -5

ls components/RadioButton/ 2>/dev/null && sed -n 1,40p components/RadioButton/RadioButton.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "=== useThemeValue"; cat components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts; echo "=== lang"; grep -rn "type Lang\|Lang =" i18n/*.d.ts components/i18n/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5
ls components/ | grep -iE "radio|segment|select" ; echo "=== Lang"; grep -rn "Lang" components/i18n/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; find . -name "configure.d.ts" | head -3

grep -n "export \* from\|export {" index.d.ts | grep -iE "theme|components|hooks" | head -8; echo "=== nav root"; grep -n "AsideHeader\|FooterItem\|types" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -10; grep -n "AsideHeaderItem" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/index.d.ts
